info.name: Astra DevOps Access List Clone API

params.name: databaseID
params.description: String representation of the database ID

params.name: from
params.description: Optional timestamp in RFC3339 format. Sets the earliest time from which to fetch snapshots. If alone, fetches all available snapshots recorded on or after the given time. Use with 'to' to create a defined range.

params.name: to
params.description: Optional timestamp in RFC3339 format. Sets the latest time from which to fetch snapshots. If alone, fetches all available snapshots recorded on or before the given time. Use with 'from' to create a defined range.

params.name: sourceRegion
params.description: When set then identifies which region to use as the source.

params.name: targetDBID
params.description: The ID of the target database that you want to clone to.

params.name: sourceDBID
params.description: The ID of the source database that you want to clone.

params.name: snapshotID
params.description: The ID of the snapshot from the source DB to use as the basis of the clone operation.

params.name: sourceRegion
params.description: The name of the region to use as the source, if cloning from a secondary region of a multi-region database.

info.name: Get the status of a clone operation.

params.name: targetDBID
params.description: The ID of the target database that you want to clone to.

params.name: operationID
params.description: The ID of the clone operation.
